data.plainLyric:
Never in the common ways
Have I chased a lesser grace
Look at me, look at me, look at me
Want nothing fleeting to chase
Call it, keep it, feel it, let it all stay
Sign it, seal it, let it deepen all day
The worth of devotion
I know it, yeah
So choose the things that last
No borrowed shine or 24-karat rings
Choose what deepens over time
Cha-Ching
Never chase the fleeting things
(I'm the finest thing)
Like the sweet scent in the air
It will linger till the end
Cha-Ching
Never chase the fleeting things
(I'm the finest thing)
Never let the moment fade
I have built what time has made
Look at me, look at me, look at me
See what is worth it
Hold it, love it, mean it, let it all stay
Build it, bind it, make it grow all the way
The strength of devotion
I feel it, yeah
So build the things that last
No borrowed shine or 24-karat rings
Choose what deepens over time
Cha-Ching
Never chase the fleeting things
(I'm the finest thing)
Like the sweet scent in the air
It will linger till the end
Cha-Ching
Never chase the fleeting things
(I'm the finest thing)
